text_en: 1. The market oscillated and diverged throughout the day, with the three major indices showing mixed gains and losses. Film and television stocks continued their strength, with Beijing Culture hitting 2 consecutive limit-ups and Huazhi Digital Media hitting the 20cm limit-up. Pharmaceutical stocks remained active, with Baihua Pharmaceutical hitting 6 consecutive limit-ups and Hayao Pharmaceutical and others hitting limit-up. The MLCC concept rallied intraday, with Shuangxing New Material and Jiemei Technology hitting limit-up. The robotics concept strengthened in the afternoon, with Juli Intelligent, Beite Technology, and Siling Zhiqu hitting limit-up. On the downside, precious metals sectors opened high and moved lower, with Chifeng Gold falling nearly 8%. Declining stocks outnumbered gainers, with nearly 3,800 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, with today's turnover at 2.34 trillion yuan. At close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.82%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.4%, and the ChiNext Index rose 0.34%. 2. In terms of sector concepts, film and television, pharmaceuticals, MLCC, and robotics led gains, while precious metals, non-ferrous metals, military, and insurance sectors led declines. 3.
